learning_outcomes.text: Explain what makes a KPI useful and how it links to strategy
Select appropriate profitability, liquidity, efficiency and return metrics
Calculate and interpret core financial ratios correctly
Design a balanced metric set that resists gaming
Benchmark metrics against peers, trends and targets responsibly
Present metrics clearly and flag their limitations
